text: When agent_workspace diverges from origin (forced update), use git reset --hard origin/agent_workspace to resync — ff-only pull will abort and leave the agent on a stale branch.

When all security findings across a batch are empty (zero-byte __init__.py files), the Cross-File Security Correlator correctly produces an empty chains artifact with zero confirmed/partial/terminated chains — this is not an error, it is the expected outcome for such a batch.
